## `#[RequiresCapability]`

`Semitexa\Authorization\Attribute\RequiresCapability`

Applies to: class. Repeatable.

| parameter | type | required |
|---|---|---|
| `capability` | `Semitexa\Authorization\Domain\Contract\CapabilityInterface` | yes |

```php

#[RequiresPermission('products.write')]
```
